scope: Static training/run-management review plus installed Lightning callback-state behavior; not a completed model/optimizer resume test.

source_review.run_management.resolve_run_directory: Explicit trainer.run_dir takes precedence over the run inferred from resume_from_checkpoint.
source_review.run_management.prepare_run: A new stage directory receives its own metadata/run.json and W&B ID. Each invocation records resolved configuration and resume_from_checkpoint.
source_review.train.UnifiedTrainer: UV resume disables model initialization paths and sets restoring_checkpoint; on_load_checkpoint validates complete model architecture.
source_review.train.main: trainer.fit(module, ckpt_path=source_checkpoint) requests Lightning full-state resume. max_steps is cumulative, so 60000 adds 30000 updates to step 30000.
source_review.train.configure_optimizers: Adam over all currently trainable model parameters; preserving parameter order/shapes and full trainability is required to reuse optimizer state.

server_142_callback_test.method: ModelCheckpoint.load_state_dict with synthetic old callback state and a distinct stage weights directory; no model training or directory creation.
server_142_callback_test.old_best_model_path_boundary: Until a new validation save, callback.best_model_path still points to the old run; do not interpret it as the best supervision-v2 checkpoint.

required_launch_settings.checkpoint_monitor: Existing val/loss; safe because stage top-k state starts empty

provenance_to_add_at_launch: Stage metadata recording source checkpoint SHA, original run, source step 30000, target step 60000, supervision-v2 protocol and full-state resume intent.
A stage reference under the original run; leave original weights, logs, W&B run and metadata snapshots intact.
runtime_checks_still_required: Strict model state and architecture validation with the actual source checkpoint.
Restored global_step=30000, optimizer state count/steps and Adam moments verified before the first update.
First new optimizer update reaches global_step=30001 and all intended model parameters remain trainable.
New loss configuration and UV target root are used after resume; source checkpoint hyperparameters must not override the newly passed configuration.
limits: Full optimizer/loop resume does not promise byte-identical future sample order from a mid-epoch checkpoint with shuffled or worker-augmented loading. New W&B stage is intentionally separate because total-loss semantics changed. No generic trainer or run-management code modification is needed.
